  THURSDAY, JANUARY 18, 2024
  4901 E. CARSON STREET
  LONG BEACH CITY COLLEGE, LIBERAL ARTS CAMPUS
  BUILDING T, ROOM 1100, 5:00 PM

Richard Lewis, Chair  Susana Gonzalez Edmond, Commissioner
Jane Templin, Vice Chair  Josh LaFarga, Commissioner
Alvaro Castillo, Commissioner  Michele Ware, Commissioner
Michael Clemson, Commissioner

  PLANNING COMMISSION IN-PERSON MEETING

  MEMBERS OF THE PUBLIC HAVE THE OPTION TO SUBMIT EMAIL COMMENTS TO
  PLANNINGCOMMISSIONERS@LONGBEACH.GOV

CALL TO ORDER

ROLL CALL

PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE

REGULAR AGENDA

1.  24-51792  Recommendation to receive and file Director’s Report.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

2.  24-51793  Recommendation to approve the minutes for the Planning Commission meeting on
  Thursday, December 21, 2023.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

3.  24-51794  Recommendation to accept Categorical Exemption (CE23-126) and approve a
  Conditional Use Permit (CUP23-023) to allow the operation of a new utility
  mounted wireless telecommunication facility on an existing Southern California
  Edison (SCE) tower at 7250 Atherton Street in the Park (P) Zoning District. (District
  4)

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

4.  24-51823  Recommendation to adopt Mitigated Negative Declaration (IS/MND-03-23) (SCH #
  2023090574); and

  Approve a Vesting Tentative Tract Map (TTM21-006) to subdivide an existing site
  located at 4501 Orange Avenue consisting of three (3) lots totaling 1.014 acres into
  one (1) master ground lot and 32 condominium airspaces in conjunction with the
  construction of 32 three-story townhomes with attached garages, which project
  was approved by the Site Plan Review Committee (SPR21-038) on January 12,

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

5.  23-25743-01 Recommendation to conduct a study session regarding a zoning ordinance
  amendment effort to update and adopt a local ordinance regulating Accessory
  Dwelling Units (ADUs), and two-unit residential developments (Senate Bill (SB) 9
  units).

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

Opportunity to address the Planning Commission on non-agenda items. Each speaker is limited to
three minutes to make their comments unless extended by the Chair.
